cfg.notes: libultraship Ship::Config. CVars live under the top-level "CVars" object, nested by the dots of the CVar name (gSettings.MSAAValue -> CVars/gSettings/MSAAValue). Bools are stored as integers 0/1. Window/backend under "Window". Read at start-up, written when settings change and on exit, so force-stop before editing. Created on first launch.

internal_resolution.label: Settings > Graphics > Internal Resolution
internal_resolution.notes: Slider 0.5-2.0 (scale of the window size). From izzy2lost/Lighthouse source and libmain.so strings; not checked against a written file.

msaa.label: Settings > Graphics > Anti-aliasing (MSAA)
msaa.notes: Slider 1-8. From izzy2lost/Lighthouse source and libmain.so strings; not checked against a written file.

interpolation_fps.label: Settings > Graphics > Current FPS
interpolation_fps.notes: 30 = Original; up to the display's max refresh (frame interpolation). From izzy2lost/Lighthouse source and libmain.so strings; not checked against a written file.

match_refresh_rate.label: Settings > Graphics > Match Refresh Rate
match_refresh_rate.notes: Checkbox CVar (stored as integer 0/1). Sets interpolation to the display refresh rate. From izzy2lost/Lighthouse source and libmain.so strings; not checked against a written file.
